name: Highly Casual | 10mg Seltzer | Honeycrisp Apple
description: Crisp, refreshing, and perfectly balanced. Our Honeycrisp seltzer captures the juicy snap of orchard-fresh apples with a clean finish that makes it easy to enjoy any time of day. Infused with 10mg of fast-acting THC, it’s designed for a steady, elevated buzz that’s social yet grounded. Whether you’re winding down after work, kicking back with friends, or swapping out your usual drink, Honeycrisp delivers a familiar flavor with a modern twist—no hangover required. Chill, sip, and stay Highly Casual.
